name: Jeanne
source:
A kind girl who shuns conflict, the bearer of an endlessly unblemished heart. She nurses the gravely injured Roland back to health at a spring near the clock tower, the saving his life. She then begins to travel the countless Regions that dot the mysterious alternate world alongside Roland.

The denizens of the mysterious world, the Silhouettes, worship her as a 'the Saint', much to her dismay.

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1230]MangaGamer[/url]]
